We’ve been using StoreRank for a couple of weeks now and honestly it feels like one of the first Shopify SEO apps that actually understands where ecommerce is heading with AI search. Most SEO apps still focus purely on Google rankings, while this app is clearly built around getting your products understood by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, etc. The automatic schema setup and FAQ generation were surprisingly good and didn’t require a developer to implement everything manually. The AI crawler access setup and llms.txt support are also a really smart addition. A lot of store owners probably don’t even realize AI crawlers struggle to properly understand Shopify stores out of the box. What I personally liked most: • Easy to use dashboard • Bulk optimization saves a lot of time • AI-focused product optimization actually gives useful suggestions • Article autopilot helps keep content publishing consistent • Mention tracking is very interesting for monitoring brand visibility across AI platforms The app also didn’t noticeably slow down our store, which was one of my biggest concerns before installing. I think this category of “AI SEO” is going to become huge over the next few years and this feels like one of the more forward-thinking apps currently available on Shopify. Would love to see even deeper customization for article generation and publishing workflows in the future, but overall very impressed so far.

We use StoreRankAI to support both AEO and SEO across our site. It’s especially helpful for generating and enhancing FAQs on product pages, as well as improving meta titles, meta descriptions, and featured image alt text. It can also be used to strengthen PDP titles and descriptions. The Pro plan is worth it if you want to bulk update products — highly recommended. Another big plus is the ability to apply your brand’s tone of voice, which makes the outputs feel on-brand rather than generic. Overall, a really solid tool that we’d recommend.

Impressive early-stage product with thoughtful execution Really solid early version. You can tell the team invested significantly in features and workflows—the user flows are well thought out. I used StoreRank for content optimization on three key PDPs we're running a major sale on. These are products we expect to drive significant growth into 2026 (feature-packed, competitive pricing), so AI discoverability matters. The optimization process was straightforward and the schema implementation didn't conflict with our theme. The concept is smart: most stores are invisible to AI search because LLMs can't parse unstructured product data well. StoreRank fixes this by automatically adding optimized schema, FAQs, and product content that tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity can actually understand and recommend. Early to measure impact on AI-driven revenue, but the foundation is strong. Looking forward to seeing how the tracking and analytics develop.
